Fatima Gill
Senior Frontend Engineer | Bangalore
fatima.gill809@example.com | +91 9940660986

Senior frontend engineer focusing on performant React applications and reliable test automation. I design and implement modular UI components, improve developer workflows, and collaborate with product and backend teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. Available after a 60 days notice period.

Experience

Bluefin Logistics — Feb 2019 - Present
Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote/Hybrid)
- Led a React and TypeScript migration of the customer shipment dashboard, reducing bundle size by 28% and improving First Contentful Paint by 38% through code-splitting and CSS refactors using CSS modules and disciplined CSS practices.
- Established a Cypress and Jest test suite for core flows, increasing end-to-end coverage to 85% for booking and tracking flows and catching regressions that reduced production incidents by 42% year-over-year.
- Implemented GraphQL client integrations and optimized queries to cut average dashboard load from 2.4s to 1.3s; collaborated with backend to add persisted queries and caching strategies.
- Improved team productivity by standardizing Git workflows, documenting component patterns in Confluence, and introducing linting and build checks on Linux CI runners.

Covalent Infotech — Mar 2018 - Jan 2019
Frontend Engineer (Onsite)
- Built responsive UI components with Tailwind CSS and CSS, accelerating page build time for new client landing pages by 50% through utility-first patterns and reusable templates.
- Contributed to a design system repository and Git-based release process, reducing UI inconsistencies across projects by 60% and lowering redesign effort for client updates.
- Partnered with product designers to implement pixel-accurate features and ran component-level Jest tests to ensure stability during iterations.
- Optimized asset delivery and CSS critical path, which improved Lighthouse accessibility and performance scores for client sites.

Projects
- Shipment Insights Widget — Developed a standalone React + GraphQL widget used by enterprise clients to visualize on-time delivery metrics; integrated with Cypress tests and deployed as a versioned npm package consumed by multiple apps.
- UI Toolkit — Created a small UI toolkit using Tailwind CSS and Storybook examples, documented in Confluence, which reduced new page implementation time for junior engineers by ~30%.

Skills
Languages: TypeScript
Frameworks/Libraries: React, GraphQL
Testing/Tools: Jest, Cypress, Git
Styling/Other: CSS, Tailwind CSS, Confluence, Linux

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
